Card Q&A.q: If a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, can this Digimon attack?

Effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon without [Gotsumon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards can't attack.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When the attack target is switched, you may unsuspend 1 of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] All of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞ get +1000 DP.
